title: Tenebris
subtitle: Darkness, in the old tongue
text: Tenebris — darkness, in the alchemical tongue. The ancient name for the Umbral tendency. Blood shaped in tenebris learns that most of existence is the absence of light, and that most of what happens in the world happens in that absence. It is not malevolent. It is simply comfortable with what others fear to acknowledge: that shadow is not the absence of something, but a presence in its own right.
